source.quote_free_summary: A contestant's marks are re-ordered best to worst and the majority mark is the middle mark for an odd panel; majority marks are sorted to place contestants.

requirement: A UCWDC engine must derive the majority mark from re-ordered marks per Rule #3 before any tiebreaker.
enforcement_point: NOT IMPLEMENTED. A blocker to activating any future UCWDC scoring profile (OD-13). A future UCWDC engine must be independently verified, separately versioned (never by editing ordinal_rank@1 or studio_ordinal_majority@1) and evaluated under OD-24. Docs-only record: no compliance claimed.
interpretation_notes: Studio uses a cutoff-count method (OM-A) that is a different formulation; equivalence to Rule #3 is not claimed or proven. Even-panel contingency rule exists in the source and is not modelled.
decision_refs: OD-13 (owner decision 2026-11-23, Option A: preserve DanceFlow Studio scoring; retrospective audit PR #795)
